build_radius_graph_preprocessing: build a graph preprocessing pipeline from AtomicData using biknn_radius_graph and spherical harmonics expansion
create_frequency_vectors: create frequency vectors for neighbor attention by computing spherical harmonics on edge direction tensors
compute_edge_distance_expansion: compute edge distance expansion using gaussian, sigmoid, linear_sigmoid, or silu smearing functions
calculate_bond_orientational_order: calculate bond-orientational order per node using spherical harmonics and neighbor direction vectors
pad_and_unpad_batch: pad a batch of molecular graphs to fixed size for torch.compile and unpad results after inference
